resolved_conflicts.explanation: The state record gives 1934 as the year built. A Forest Lookouts list gives a 1916 entry for a 55-foot steel tower as a primary lookout. The sources do not say they are the same structure, so the story reports both dates and does not merge them.

notes_for_editor: The 1934 build year and DNR staffing to 2015 come from one state inventory record, not a second source. The 1916 Forest Lookouts entry conflicts with 1934 and may describe an earlier structure on the site; left open. The state record places the tower in Boulder Junction township and on Plum Firetower Road, and that is what the story says. Current access and visiting rules are not in any source, so they are omitted. Cross-check: WJFW dates the statewide decommissioning to 2015, while the Saddle Mound story says 2016; that discrepancy is for the editor to settle across towers. Leader-Telegram article on the 2015 closure returned HTTP 429 and was not read.
